title: Code and data for: Physics-informed residual learning of descriptor power-network models with enforced algebraic constraints: prediction, contingency margins and a control test
description: Python code, MATPOWER case9 and case39 input files, generated tables (CSV), figures and tests that reproduce all numerical results of the manuscript prepared for Electric Power Systems Research (Elsevier).
